Threads element-wise over a list, as Wolfram's Listable heads do
Listable: threads over its limits at $\pm\infty$, unbounded unlike Erfc's saturating 0/2
Erfi(ComplexInfinity) is Indeterminate, inheriting Erf's direction-dependent growth off the real axis
wolfram.note: Wolfram leaves Erfi[ComplexInfinity] unevaluated; ours answers Indeterminate (erfi diverges or tends to ±i by direction)
